$description: LAYER 1 — GLOBAL FONT, Template B (Harvard-PLL / tels-mirror). Change brand typeface HERE only. Cascades via --pgn-typography-font-family-* + overrides/_typography.scss. Do not set font-family on * (breaks .fa icons).

serif.$description: ★ BRAND FONT STACK — edit this string to change typeface site-wide. Must be a comma-separated STRING (not a JSON array). tels-mirror is serif-first: html/body/h1-h4 all default to Merriweather (key name kept as 'sans.serif' for parity with existing Layer-2 references — it holds whatever the body typeface is, not literally a sans font here).

base.$description: Body / UI font → --pgn-typography-font-family-base (links to sans.serif above)

ui.$description: UI chrome font (buttons, nav, uppercase labels, filter bar) → --pgn-typography-font-family-ui. tels-mirror's second family (--font-sans) — body copy/headings stay serif, only interactive chrome uses this.

base.$description: UI label: Body font size → --pgn-typography-font-size-base. 16px, matches tels-mirror's unstyled body text.
